name: MediaLog
description: Everything you’ve watched, read, played, listened to, on one timeline.

facts.fact: Log films, books, shows, games, albums and podcasts.
Entries record when something was experienced and how it was.
See what the people you know have been into.
The supplied design groups its timeline into five-year periods and supports approximate dates.
Media types have distinct accent colours; navy typography sits on a pale blue-grey background.

artwork: Original vector emblems and path-drawn wordmarks. The logo screenshot defines the size, not the motif. No ASCII or character-art renderer is used.
batch: Second compact logo draw: twenty graphic styles, excluding all previous saved draws, with no ASCII.

brief.subject: MediaLog logo and brand title
brief.motif: Invent new symbols appropriate to a shared media diary; the screenshot supplies size and aspect ratio only.
brief.detail: No tagline, mock interface, tiny captions, ASCII or character art. Bold icons and path-based wordmarks.
